hi.register: Warm, clear, conversational Hindi. Use respectful आप in devotional guidance; preserve तुम/तू only inside established Scripture wording or direct prayer when intentional.

fr.register: Devotional prose uses warm singular tu; Scripture quotations retain the wording of the chosen Bible translation, including vous where present.

id.register: Use warm kamu in devotional prose. Use Allah in Scripture and direct references to God; Tuhan where idiomatic in narrative and prayer.

es.register: Warm singular tú; natural Christian devotional Spanish.

pt.register: Warm Brazilian Portuguese with você; natural Christian devotional wording.

fil.register: Natural conversational Filipino Christian language; avoid stiff word-for-word English syntax.

de.register: Warm singular du; established German Bible names and Christian terminology.
